ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the plane is tiled by congruent squares and congruent pentagons. It can be seen that the horizontal and vertical lines form an obvious grid of unit small squares; the oblique sides repeat in the same way, and the pattern repeats once every 3 small-square side lengths in the horizontal and vertical directions. Reasoning: Therefore take a 3×3 unit grid block as the basic repeating region, whose total area is the area of 9 unit small squares. Counting from the figure, there are 4 complete square tiles in such a 3×3 repeating block. The problem states that the whole plane is tiled only by these squares and pentagons, so the remaining area in this repeating block all belongs to pentagons. The area occupied by pentagons is 9 - 4 = 5 unit areas, and the ratio is 5/9 ≈ 55.6%. Taking the nearest integer as a percentage gives 56%.

raw_record.question_text: The plane is tiled by congruent squares and congruent pentagons as indicated in the figure. What percent of the plane is enclosed by the pentagons?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the square tiles form an obvious unit square grid, and the slanted pentagon edges repeat in the same pattern every 3 small-square side lengths horizontally and vertically. Use one 3-by-3 repeat block as a fundamental region. From the image, within such a 3-by-3 block, exactly four of the nine unit grid cells are complete square tiles; all other area in the block belongs to pentagon tiles, since the text says the plane is tiled only by congruent squares and congruent pentagons. Thus the pentagon area fraction is (9 - 4)/9 = 5/9 ≈ 55.6%, which rounds to 56%.

推理：因此取一个 3×3 的单位网格块作为基本重复区域，其总面积为 9 个单位小正方形面积。从图中数出，在这样的 3×3 重复块内有 4 个完整的正方形瓷砖。题目说明整个平面只由这些正方形和五边形铺成，所以该重复块中剩余面积都属于五边形。五边形所占面积为 9 - 4 = 5 个单位面积，比例为 5/9 ≈ 55.6%。按百分数取最接近的整数为 56%。
